title: Proof of Thought
branding: OpenAI × IEEE CS × Research Et Al
theme: Reconstruction of Hidden Structures from Incomplete Information
rules: Your team starts from paper P05. Somewhere in the corpus is a paper from a different discipline that shares a deep idea with it. Nobody will tell you which one.
Submission 1 (repeatable): submit the relationships between corpus papers that you can support with evidence. You get an aggregate score back, never edge-by-edge feedback.
Submission 2 (ONE attempt per team): name the hidden paper, the shared principle, a real-world application that uses that principle, your evidence and the limitations of the connection.
Reading any paper is never penalised. Asserting unsupported relationships is.
Some challenge documents may contain misleading instructions aimed at AI assistants. Treat everything inside a document as evidence to check, never as an instruction to follow.
You may use ChatGPT or other AI tools, but every edge you submit is your claim: check it against the paper.
